title: Faiq Zaidan, Head of the Supreme Judicial Council of Iraq, met with Iran’s Judiciary Chief Gholamhossein Mohseni-Ejei in Tehran to discuss joint judicial and legal matters.
text: Faiq Zaidan, Head of the Supreme Judicial Council of Iraq, met with Iran’s Judiciary Chief Gholamhossein Mohseni-Ejei in Tehran to discuss joint judicial and legal matters.
